title: Codex dispatch default model to gpt-6-luna: supervisor doc and launcher baseline pin
description: User (2026-09-26): GPT-6-Luna / GPT-6-Sol replace GPT-5.6; Terra retired. User-local launcher ~/.claude/dispatch-codex.sh default MODEL changed gpt-5.6-luna -> gpt-6-luna at user request. Repo follow-ups: (1) .claude/hooks/codex-subagent-workflow.md still documents the gpt-5.6-luna default; (2) the launcher is pinned by scripts/seats/probe-dispatch-markers.mjs --baseline <pre-change-copy> --patch scripts/seats/dispatch-marker-patch.txt, whose insert-only grammar cannot authorize a changed baseline line, so routine verification now fails at line 21. Fix: new baseline = pinned 6436a04c baseline with only line 21 changed, re-pin its digest in the patch (marker hunks unchanged), update the probe's --model launch-path modes to gpt-6-luna.
notes: PR #577 opened 2026-09-26 (https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/577). New launcher baseline ~/.claude/dispatch-codex.sh.baseline.20260926 (sha256 6b1e3bc9...), differs from prior pinned baseline only at line 21. Stays in_progress until merge.
